verdict.rationale: Kling documents native audio co-generation of sound effects and ambient sound alongside video starting with Kling 2.6. Its pricing lists a 'with audio' generation tier, so scene-matched audio is produced inside the same tool. The evidence is a single thin first-party line plus a pricing entry; scene matching is only implied by 'co-generation', and music generation is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit music generation, detailed docs on how audio is matched to scene content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Native audio co-generation (speech, sound effects, ambient sound) introduced in Kling 2.6 (December 2025)
